quotes.text: Mr. Lee, I want to begin with you, and I am wondering if you, briefly, could just say how does this bill on day one make the internet a safer place for consumers across the country?

[...] We must protect Americans from these dangers with comprehensive federal data privacy legislation. This must be the foundation we build upon to regulate AI.
